item.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' 'The proposed update extends the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. In a twenty-four-hour benchmark, it produced eighteen percent fewer origin requests. However, that benchmark did not measure the incidence of stale reads, so the result does not establish how the longer lifetime affects them. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout; in short, the approval should remain limited and conditional.' | wc -w"
